title: Foot shape-function model data (Schuster, 100 people, PLY scans)
notes: Filename suffix: R = right foot as scanned; Lr = LEFT-dominant participant's scan, reflected about its length axis so it looks like a right foot (per README); L (only 001_*) = a left foot that README does not explain and which is NOT mirrored. Mirror 001 before pooling with the others.
No arch labels: all participants healthy. mBW vs fBW pairs give an arch-drop-under-load measure.

title: Plantar pressure dataset for foot health assessment (400 images, 5 classes)
notes: UPSTREAM DATA LOSS: the zip itself (MD5 matches Zenodo) contains zero-byte PNGs, so only the non-empty files are usable (see zero_byte_pngs / loadable).

NO CLASS LABELS SHIPPED: 400 PNGs named by timestamp (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) in one flat folder; no label file, no class folders, no metadata in the zip or the Zenodo record. The 5 classes are only named in the description. Labels must be obtained from the authors or assigned by hand before supervised training.
Collected at a shoe store with a Footbird 3.0 scanner; some images may be mixed types.

title: High-density plantar pressure, rectus vs valgus alignment (32x32 FSR CSV)
notes: Labels per file: left and right REARFOOT alignment (rectus/valgus) from Tibial-Calcaneal Angle, not arch type. Useful for alignment, not flat-foot, classification.
.rar uses the RAR v6 method: 7zz 26.04 fails ('Unsupported Method'), bsdtar extracts it.
Zenodo record also holds 4 example PNG intensity maps (Rectus_Rectus.png etc.).

title: CAD WALK Healthy Controls (55 adults, RSscan pressure)
notes: Pressure videos as NIfTI (rows x cols x frames), left_foot_trial_N / right_foot_trial_N per subject; per-subject xlsx plus metadata.xlsx and Readme.pdf. Labels are cohort-level only.

title: CAD WALK Hallux Valgus, pre-surgery (50 patients)
notes: Pressure videos as NIfTI (rows x cols x frames), left_foot_trial_N / right_foot_trial_N per subject; per-subject xlsx plus metadata.xlsx and Readme.pdf. Labels are cohort-level only.

title: Pesplanus Dataset (weight-bearing lateral X-rays, 842 images)
notes: Mendeley's API gives unnamed class folders; labels are inferred from folder file counts matching the dataset description (402 pes planus, 440 normal). Spot-check before trusting.
Labels: calcaneal inclination <18 deg = pes planus (2 radiologists + a third for conflicts).

LEAKAGE RISK: the 842 files are only as many unique images as 'unique_images_by_sha256' (byte-identical duplicates, apparently from re-exporting); numeric filename prefixes are reused across classes and 'N L (k)' names are a separate series, so filenames do NOT identify patients. Dedupe by hash before splitting (no duplicate group spans both classes, so labels are consistent).

title: Takata flatfoot plantar pressure and gait cycle (20 flat + 21 normal women)
notes: Sheets MAXP (peak pressure), CA (contact area), GC (gait-phase times); columns are foot regions x {LOW, NORMAL}. Group means per row, not raw frames. Flat group = 'LOW' (arch), per paper: 20 FF vs 21 NF women.

title: MUN104 mean plantar pressure template (104 healthy subjects, L/R)
notes: Mean of 104 healthy subjects per foot; integer-valued grid, rows = long axis. Not per-subject. No published checksum: sha256 recorded by fetch.py on first download (see hashes in manifest).
